title.narrative: Pacific countries invested in designing strategies for transforming education (5 countries), largely with a focus on strengthening teaching practice, and efforts continued in teacher capacity building on inclusive education (2 countries), both with an aim to improve equitable learning outcomes. In the face of recurrent disasters and with climate change increasingly threatening the region, Pacific countries are strengthening attention resilience in schools, including school-based disaster risk reduction (3 countries) and resilient infrastructure (2 countries), while responding to emergencies when needed. Finally, Pacific countries are leading new efforts to strengthen multi-sectoral support to student health and well-being, including through improved coordination of health, nutrition, WASH and protection measures in schools (4 countries).
